## ResourceTable type

An app contract's resource table: every resource references can point to, keyed by manifest resource key.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ResourceTable = Readonly<Record<string, ResourceDescriptor<unknown>>>
```

**References:** [ResourceDescriptor](./contracts.resourcedescriptor.md)

## Remarks

This is the widest table, whose keys are not known. A generated contract declares a narrower one, the literal type of its table, so that its clients can check references statically.
